name: mcp-code-context
description: Powerful MCP server with Tree-sitter WASM parsers for 100% AST accuracy. Zero native dependencies. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Dart, and Python.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node dist-tests/tests/test-wasm-parsers.js
scripts.test:legacy: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node dist-tests/tests/test-dart.js && node dist-tests/tests/test-php.js && node dist-tests/tests/writers/test-write-smoke.js && node dist-tests/tests/test-new-tools.js && node dist-tests/tests/test-backup-system.js && node dist-tests/tests/test-rename-limitations.js
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test
